articles.title_en: Russian drone developer seriously injured in car explosion in Yekaterinburg
articles.lead_en: Vladimir Tkachuk, CEO of Uraldronzavod and creator of the Telegram channel Povernutye na voine (“Obsessed with the war”), was injured in Yekaterinburg when his Mercedes exploded, according to the Russian business daily Kommersant and the Russian state news agency TASS.

articles.title_en: Son-in-law of Russian Aerospace Forces Commander Alexander Chayko killed in Moscow restaurant blast
articles.lead_en: Daniil Peredriy, son-in-law of Aerospace Forces Commander Alexander Chayko, was killed in the August 1 explosion at the Italian restaurant Balzi Rossi in Moscow. Leaked data from two government databases confirms his death, the independent Russian investigative outlet Agentstvo reported.

articles.title_en: Ukraine has hit 20 Wildberries warehouses since mid-July. Photos and videos show the aftermath of the latest strike on a logistics center in Russia’s Leningrad region.
articles.lead_en: Overnight on August 4, Ukrainian drones attacked a Wildberries warehouse in the village of Krasny Bor in Russia’s Leningrad region, sparking a major fire. The company says it carried out an “advance evacuation” of employees and that no one was injured.

articles.title_en: Did Russian air defenses bring down the Ukrainian drone that killed seven on a Black Sea beach?
articles.lead_en: A Ukrainian drone came down on a beach crowded with vacationers in the village of Arkhipo-Osipovka near Gelendzhik on the morning of August 3. Seven people died, including three children, and 40 more were injured, 21 of them hospitalized, according to data from the Krasnodar Krai operational headquarters.
